# Apollo.io MCP Server and CLI

> Apollo.io Model Context Protocol server and command-line tool by The VGER Group for B2B prospecting, account research, contact enrichment, company enrichment, job-posting research, and company news discovery.

The Apollo.io MCP Server and CLI lets Claude Desktop, other MCP clients, and terminal users work with Apollo.io sales intelligence data. It is designed for practical user workflows: finding prospects, researching target accounts, enriching known contacts and companies, and checking company news.

## Primary Docs

- [README](https://github.com/thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp#readme): User-focused install guide, Claude Desktop `.mcpb` setup, quick prompts, update checks, and troubleshooting.
- [CLI Guide](https://github.com/thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp/blob/main/CLI.md): Complete command-line usage for Apollo.io people search, company search, enrichment, jobs, and news.
- [Developer Guide](https://github.com/thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp/blob/main/docs/development/developer-guide.md): Source setup, MCP Inspector, tool schemas, filter references, testing, skills output, and release checks.
- [Testing Guide](https://github.com/thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp/blob/main/docs/development/testing.md): Unit, integration, installer, MCPB, and release validation notes.
- [Release Guide](https://github.com/thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp/blob/main/RELEASING.md): Versioning and publishing workflow.

## Install

- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp/releases): Download the newest `apollo-io-mcp-v*.mcpb` bundle for the easiest Claude Desktop install.
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp): Install or run `@thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp` with npm and npx.

## User Commands

- `npx @thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp@latest setup`: Install the MCP server in Claude Desktop.
- `npx @thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp@latest doctor`: Check Claude Desktop config, runtime versions, and npm update status.
- `npx @thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp@latest remove`: Remove the Apollo MCP server from Claude Desktop config.
- `npx @thevgergroup/apollo-io-mcp@latest skills`: Print install and tool-selection guidance for agents and humans.

## MCP Tools

- `apollo_search_people`: Build prospect lists by title, seniority, department, company, location, industry, and technologies.
- `apollo_search_companies`: Find target accounts by location, size, industry keywords, technologies, revenue, funding, or job postings.
- `apollo_enrich_person`: Enrich one known person by email, LinkedIn URL, or name plus company.
- `apollo_enrich_company`: Enrich one known company by domain or name.
- `apollo_bulk_enrich_people`: Enrich a batch of known people.
- `apollo_bulk_enrich_organizations`: Enrich a batch of known companies.
- `apollo_get_organization_job_postings`: Get job postings for a known Apollo organization ID.
- `apollo_get_complete_organization_info`: Get complete details for a known Apollo organization ID.
- `apollo_search_news_articles`: Search company news and events.

## Agent Notes

- Prefer the `.mcpb` install path when helping regular Claude Desktop users.
- Use people search for prospect lists, not one-off identity lookup.
- Use person enrichment for a known contact with an email, LinkedIn URL, or name plus company.
- Start searches with title or role plus location, then add company size, industry, technology, revenue, or funding filters.
- Apollo API permissions, plan access, credits, and rate limits can affect available data.
- Do not expose Apollo API keys in prompts, logs, screenshots, or GitHub issues.
